meta.units: mm, plan coordinates (same as floor_plan.json: +x right, +y down the page)
meta.layout: Per owner's sketch (2026-10-25): bed along the window, flush top-right, headboard on the east wall; long table along the bed's south side; L-shaped wardrobe in the south-east corner; TV on the west wall facing the bed.
meta.orientation: North = facade/window wall (top of plan). East = facade side wall (right). South = Bath/WC 1 wall with the WC door at x 11950-12650. West = Bedroom 2 wall; lobby + room door to the south-west.
meta.note: Product sizes are typical catalogue sizes; confirm before carpentry is fabricated.

interior.note: Wall-face to wall-face, assuming 150 mm internal / 200 mm external walls: ~3125 W x 4250 L. Verify on site.

bed.note: Long side under the window, headboard on the east wall. Get in from the foot (west end) - north is the window wall, south is the table.

desk.note: Long study / vanity table, 1990 W x 600 D, along the bed's south side. Knee space on the left (chair), drawer pedestal on the right next to the cosmetics bay. Doubles as the bedside table.

legs.name: East
legs.note: Along the east wall, facing west into the dressing area.

sections.note: Open bay next to the table: mirror, LED shelf, counter + drawers. Reachable from both his and her side.

legs.name: South
legs.note: Along the south wall from just past the WC door, facing north.

sections.note: Last 600 runs behind the east leg (blind corner); the rod continues into it for out-of-season clothes.

wardrobe.note: L-shaped, full height, 600 D. Doors not drawn (owner wants it shown open). Dressing area between the table and the south leg: ~1500 x 1250.

console.note: Floating TV console, 1400 L x 350 D

tv.note: Centred on the bed. ~2.8 m from the pillows, ~1.1 m from the foot of the bed.
